description: This file defines an 'AdvancedOptions' React functional component, which renders a UI for managing advanced account settings such as private username mode, strict sign-in, recovery codes, and custom sync server. It includes state management, side effects, and event handlers for toggling and updating these options.

classes.name: AdvancedOptions
classes.description: A React functional component for rendering and managing advanced account options such as privacy mode, recovery codes, and custom server settings.

methods.name: toggleShowAdvanced
methods.description: Toggles the visibility of the advanced options section.

methods.name: handleIsPrivateUsernameChange
methods.description: Handles toggling of the private username mode.

methods.name: handlePrivateUsernameNameChange
methods.description: Updates the private username state when user input changes.

methods.name: handleIsRecoveryCodesChange
methods.description: Handles toggling of recovery codes usage and resets related states.

methods.name: handleServerOptionChange
methods.description: Handles toggling of the custom sync server option.

methods.name: handleSyncServerChange
methods.description: Updates the custom sync server address.
